# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Use [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/Agash/VTubeStudio.Client/security/advisories/new) to report privately. You should receive an acknowledgement within a few days.

When reporting, please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Steps to reproduce.
- A suggested fix, if you have one.

## Supported versions

This is a community-maintained library. Only the latest released version on NuGet receives security fixes.

## Disclosure timeline

Once a fix is released, we'll publish a coordinated security advisory crediting the reporter (unless they prefer to remain anonymous).
